-- Registros recentes do Luciano em bpo_charges (últimas 48h)
SELECT id, type, value, due_date, status, description, classified_by, source, created_at
FROM bpo_charges
WHERE client_email = 'gabnercorporation@gmail.com'
  AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
